title: (Esports) Event microsites (Fantasy/Prediction/General)
card_note: Building Esports Home, Fantasy and Prediction events microsites with cross-functional teams (BE, FE, Design,...)

metrics.label: visit each month for Esports Home

actions:
I built & renewed the mechanism of event microsites with an in-house development team every season and year. The objective were to:

- Maintain the interest for audience/users, drive retention.
- Utilize DAU events to boost the conversion rate of casual users (non-esports fans) into esports fans by providing extra motivation for them to watch and learn the tournaments.
- Enhance awareness and providing information of the leagues
- Foster interaction/engagement within the community.

3 big sites that I built:

- **Esports Home:** Where you can find news, information, standings, and tournament updates.
- **Fantasy Event:** This is the event microsite where you can select player to build a dream team before matches start to earn points based on player’s performance and exchange rewards
- **Prediction Event:** This is where you can make predictions about players and teams to earn points and exchange them for rewards.
results: Esports home: 500K users at peak in season I, maintaining at >350K avg visits each month (in 1.5 years), with >900K avg sessions each season
Fantasy microsite (Dream Team Event): 650K users at peak, avg 600K users, with total sessions increasing by 1.8 times each season, average duration ~2 minutes
Prediction microsite: 700K users at peak, avg 500K users, with total sessions increasing by ~1.35 times each season, average duration 1.10 minutes
